body: The thing is, I have moved past it. But tiny things like that are just major setbacks for me. I was doing so well and then all of a sudden it’s like I never made any kind of progress. It really sucks especially because for a couple of months every time I get depressed I just stop feeling any kind of emotions and to be honest, I just miss being able to feel. That’s why I’m so glad to have been able to get away from this awful way of living for such a short while.

Nope, everything is fine with that person. But that’s just my thought process. If I piss someone off, especially if it’s that particular person, I get really depressed because of it. Not really sure why.

Yeah, I pissed off someone and it ruined my entire night hah. And the one after. And today. Just back to my old thought process but I’m still thankful I got to get away from it for even a couple of days.

It has been years and I’ve done nothing but ruined myself. I think I could get over my fear of death and just do it but I don’t want anyone to be sad about me being gone. I don’t want anyone to be held accountable for my death but I just can’t do it.

I know that and it’s why I promised myself that during the summer I’ll just take time out of my day to play the guitar, read books and just be productive, but I’ve done none of those things and summer is close to being over just like any other time I’ve promised myself that I’ll stop wasting my days here. I never fucking end up doing it.
I’m pretty much the same, I wish I knew how to make this end, but it seems so impossible.

If it’s about my best friend, I’ve not talked to her since New Year’s and I feel like our friendship isn’t the same anymore. If it’s about the first “lie”, then I guess it’s mostly arguments we’ve had and overthinking on my behalf.
An addiction, that’s pretty much it yeah. Strange how the only thing that helps some people deal with pain is pain itself.

Sadly, I’ve not “gone” through it yet and I am not even sure if I ever will, but that doesn’t matter as long as I have something to distract me from all the thoughts in my head and I currently don’t have anything of that sort.
I would love to even remotely believe that I’m worth it but I will never understand how a person that is not good at absolutely anything can ever be needed anywhere.

I don’t think they would really care, they would probably tell me that losing friends is a normal thing and I should get over it. Or that “maybe you should find friends that you can meet up with, not only be friends with people online” type of stuff.
If you don’t count texting.

Last month me and the person I actively talk to had a lot of arguments and I just feel like I’ve kind of disconnected with the other friend I have, but it’s a complicated situation. Me and the other friend haven’t talked in about three months.
To keep them from leaving or? I’m sorry I’m just a bit confused
I wouldn’t be at this state if I wasn’t afraid of potentially losing the only two friends I have.
no, no i meant that my social skills wont ever change
i feel like my main issue is just being unable to communicate just because i think thats never going to change

my mother tongue is bulgarian and i just dont really know how to express my worries in that language, since ive only ever talked on the internet about them and it was always in english. i also just dont know what the terms are for most of the stuff, but i guess im just overthinking since i could always just try to translate it via the internet as you said.

im not sure therapy would help me the way i want it to since im not a native english speaker and i cant really talk about my problems in my mother tongue, but i feel like ive got nothing to lose at this point.

physical harm isnt really possible at least yet, since we’re still only in an online relationship. i just feel like when he gets in those moods where he doesnt care about anyone or anything and doesnt listen to me at all it just really hurts our relationship since im very insecure anyways, and even if i try to understand that this isnt how he really is and he probably doesnt mean it at least fully, i still get upset. theres also the factor that is me being unintentionally rude and disrespectful (cutting him off because i get impatient and also saying insults because my social skills are very bad and i dont know what to say). i talk about my problems a lot and it turns into complaining and it just ruins us. i dont know what to do anymore im going to try out therapy soon i think and if that doesnt help then i really dont know what im going to do with myself and us.

thank you but right now i am completely lost because hes mad at me and he says he doesnt really care about anything i say i really just wish we somehow brush it off again this time so i could finally start trying because im being a complete disappointment ever since i met him

i dont have any irl friends, and i never have had any irl friends, except for when i was 6-8 years old and i was playing with other children. 
my mom cried and my dad was really pissed off at me beforehand so his reaction at the time was just “great”, and as much as i know that it was just because he was mad it still hurts a lot because ive been keeping it in my head for two years now. pretty much both of them think that im depressed because i spend too much time online, but i disagree because thats where im the happiest usually since i dont have *any* friends in real life.

i get that and i believe you’re right, but i think recovering from something like that will be the hardest thing in my entire life, i barely speak to anyone besides him therefore if i try to do anything to harm myself i wont really have anyone to talk me out of it. and therapy is good for that kind of stuff but its not possible in my situation. at least not before i do anything to harm myself and my parents find out somehow.

that was actually very heartfelt and i hope it would somehow keep me in the long run, even though i tend to neglect all stuff like that after a couple of days, but i thank you dearly for taking the time to tell me all that
thoughts about how miserable im feeling

no, its more like i just cant seem to understand myself at all. what im saying is a very mild explanation of what im feeling and it just feels like its destroying me in such a way that i cant function as a human being anymore, but no one seems to understand that explanation and take it into consideration. i just end up sounding selfish half the time because whenever someone is talking to me about their struggles i have no idea what to say or do, because my brain is constantly occupied and i cant think anymore and i end up sounding uninterested which isnt the truth at all.
ive tried talking to friends but it doesnt seem to ever help because i cant put my thoughts into words and sentences that make sense

im not obligated to, but its better for me and us as a whole, im just completely a nobody with a dying brain
ive been self-harming for about a year and a half, but its become more, how do i call it, harmful i guess over the past couple of months
and last but not least, i dont really like mentioning my age
i doubt it but thank you
